author: B. C. Morton
title: Village of Hastings-on-Hudson announces schedule of community events for late June
text:
The Village of Hastings-on-Hudson announced on June 17 a series of community events scheduled to take place from June 20 through June 26 at various locations throughout the village.
The Farmer’s Market will be held on Saturday, June 20, from 8:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. at the Zinsser Commuter Lot. Rivertown Thrift will operate at 3 Spring Street on Saturday, June 20, from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m.; Sunday, June 21, from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m.; and Wednesday through Friday, June 24-26, each day from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m.
Hastings Take It or Leave It (TILI) is scheduled for Sunday, June 21, from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m., taking place in Andrus On Hudson’s lower garage. Also on Sunday, the ‘Hastings on Jazz’ event will occur at VFW Plaza between 3 p.m. and 5:30 p.m.
Senior Thursday is planned for Thursday, June 25; further details were not provided in the announcement. The Summer Reading Kickoff Celebration is set for Friday, June 26, from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m., hosted by the Hastings Public Library.
Additional information about these events can be found by visiting the Village of Hastings-on-Hudson’s official website.
